title: IPS resident and contracted doctors’ staggered stoppages over seniority recognition
possible_unit_owner: paraguay_2020-12; unresolved exact physical onset and episode boundary
notes: La Nación on 31 December reports staggered stoppages were already continuing before January; exact first physical date is unsupported. January reporting separately confirms outside-IPS mobilizations on 3–5 January, recorded as candidate E004 with pending_unit status. Whether the December stoppage series and Jan 3–5 gatherings form one uninterrupted physical episode remains unresolved; this continuation context does not claim that they are the same event. A 7 December protest on the same demand is mentioned but no continuous physical episode from that date is established. The planned 8 January strike was reported lifted on 6 January; HOY reproduces a separate IPS statement about a 11–13 January plan. Neither future plan establishes a physical end. Attendance is unknown; workforce counts of 51, 60, 62, 70, 200, or 300 are not turnout.
